questions.question: In the third year of King Cyrus of Persia, Daniel received a true message in a vision. What was it about?
The man dressed in linen whom Daniel saw by the Tigris river looked just like any ordinary man. True or false?
In Daniel's vision, who came to help the messenger after the prince of Persia opposed him for twenty-one days?
The man who appeared to Daniel by the Tigris river said he had come to explain what?

answers.text: What will happen to Daniel's people in the latter days
Why Daniel's men ran away and hid by the river
How Daniel should bring his time of mourning to an end
